Reflection gives 2 int_0^(1+L/2) min(v,L)^r min(v+h-1,L)^k dv; subtracting h=3 yields a positive finite binomial sum. The range pushforward moment integral int (L-s)_+^b d nu_{p-1}= (p-1)! b!/(p+b-2)! (2-s)^(p+b-2) also holds as a point-mass when p=2. Integrating recovers all finite-sum coefficients, V(1)=2^d p!q!/d!, V(3)/V(1)=1+2k/[p(q-k+1)], increasing deletion increments 2(q+1)/[p(q-k)(q-k+1)], and first nonzero endpoint deficit 2^k k(p-1)!(q-k)!/(p+q-k)! (3-h)^(p+q-k). Hence exactly C^(p+q-k-1) across h=3, not next order.
